export interface TableData {

   * @zh 数据行的key

  /**
   * @zh 扩展行内容

  /**
   * @zh 子数据

  /**
   * @zh 是否禁用行选择器
   * @en Whether to disable the row selector
   */

  /**
   * @zh 是否是叶子节点

   */

  [name: string]: any
}

export interface TableSortable {
  /**
   * @zh 支持的排序方向
   * @en Supported sort direction
   */
  sortDirections: ('ascend' | 'descend')[]
  /**
   * @zh 排序函数需根据 `extra.direction` 自行处理升降序，组件不会再次反转结果。设置为 `true` 可关闭内部排序。
   * @en The comparator must handle `extra.direction` itself; the table does not reverse its result. Set to `true` to disable internal sorting.
   */
  sorter?:
    | ((a: TableData, b: TableData, extra: { dataIndex: string; direction: 'ascend' | 'descend' }) => number)
    | boolean
  /**
   * @zh 排序方向
   * @en Sort direction
   */
  sortOrder?: 'ascend' | 'descend' | ''
  /**
   * @zh 默认排序方向（非受控模式）
   * @en Default sort direction (uncontrolled mode)
   */
  defaultSortOrder?: 'ascend' | 'descend' | ''
}

export interface TableFilterable {
  /**
   * @zh 筛选数据
   * @en Filter data
   */
  filters?: TableFilterData[]
  /**
   * @zh 筛选函数
   * @en Filter function
   */
  filter: (filteredValue: string[], record: TableData) => boolean
  /**
   * @zh 是否支持多选
   * @en Whether to support multiple selection
   */
  multiple?: boolean
  /**
   * @zh 筛选项
   * @en Filter value
   */
  filteredValue?: string[]
  /**
   * @zh 默认筛选项
   * @en Default filter value
   */
  defaultFilteredValue?: string[]
  /**
   * @zh 筛选框的内容
   * @en The content of filter box
   */
  renderContent?: (data: {
    filterValue: string[]
    setFilterValue: (filterValue: string[]) => void
    handleFilterConfirm: (event: Event) => void
    handleFilterReset: (event: Event) => void
  }) => VNodeChild
  /**
   * @zh 筛选按钮的图标
   * @en Filter icon for button
   */

  /**
   * @zh 筛选框的弹出框配置
   * @en Pop-up box configuration of filter box
   */
  triggerProps?: TriggerProps
  /**
   * @zh 筛选图标是否左对齐
   * @en Whether the filter icon is aligned to the left
   */
  alignLeft?: boolean

  slotName?: string
}

export interface TableColumnData {
  /**
   * @zh 列信息的标识，对应 `TableData` 中的数据
   * @en The identifier of the column information, corresponding to the data in `TableData`
   */
  dataIndex?: string
  /**
   * @zh 列标题
   * @en Column header
   */
  title?: string | RenderFunction
  /**
   * @zh 列宽度。设置后为固定列宽，不参与剩余空间分配
   * @en Column width. Fixed width when set; does not participate in remaining space distribution
   */
  width?: number
  /**
   * @zh 最小列宽。未设置 `width` 的列按 `minWidth` 比例分配剩余空间；默认 80
   * @en Minimum column width. Columns without `width` share remaining space by `minWidth` ratio; defaults to 80
   */
  minWidth?: number
  /**
   * @zh 对齐方向
   * @en Alignment direction
   */
  align?: 'left' | 'center' | 'right'
  /**
   * @zh 固定位置
   * @en Fixed position
   */
  fixed?: 'left' | 'right'
  /**
   * @zh 是否显示省略号
   * @en Whether to show ellipsis
   */
  ellipsis?: boolean
  /**
   * @zh 是否在显示省略号时显示文本提示。可填入 tooltip 组件属性
   * @en Whether to show a text hint when an ellipsis is displayed. Can be filled in tooltip component properties
   */
  tooltip?: boolean | Record<string, any>
  /**
   * @zh 排序相关选项
   * @en Sorting related options
   */
  sortable?: TableSortable
  /**
   * @zh 过滤相关选项
   * @en Filter related options
   */
  filterable?: TableFilterable
  /**
   * @zh 表头子数据，用于表头分组
   * @en Header sub-data, used for header grouping
   */
  children?: TableColumnData[]
  /**
   * @zh 自定义单元格类名
   * @en Custom cell class
   */
  cellClass?: ClassName
  /**
   * @zh 自定义表头单元格类名
   * @en Custom header cell class
   */
  headerCellClass?: ClassName
  /**
   * @zh 自定义内容单元格类名
   * @en Custom body cell class
   */
  bodyCellClass?: ClassName | ((record: TableData) => ClassName)
  /**
   * @zh 自定义总结栏单元格类名
   * @en Custom body cell class
   */
  summaryCellClass?: ClassName | ((record: TableData) => ClassName)
  /**
   * @zh 自定义单元格样式
   * @en Custom cell style
   */
  cellStyle?: CSSProperties
  /**
   * @zh 自定义表头单元格样式
   * @en Custom header cell style
   */
  headerCellStyle?: CSSProperties
  /**
   * @zh 自定义内容单元格样式
   * @en Custom body cell style
   */
  bodyCellStyle?: CSSProperties | ((record: TableData) => CSSProperties)
  /**
   * @zh 自定义总结栏单元格样式
   * @en Custom summary cell style
   */
  summaryCellStyle?: CSSProperties | ((record: TableData) => CSSProperties)
  /**
   * @zh 自定义列单元格的渲染
   * @en Customize the rendering of column cells
   */
  render?: (data: { record: TableData; column: TableColumnData; rowIndex: number }) => VNodeChild
  /**
   * @zh 设置当前列的渲染插槽的名字。插槽参数同 #cell
   * @en Sets the name of the render slot for the current column. Slot parameters are the same as #cell
   */
  slotName?: string
  /**
   * @zh 设置当前列的标题的渲染插槽的名字
   * @en Set the name of the render slot for the header of the current column
   */
  titleSlotName?: string

  // private
  slots?: Slots
  isLastLeftFixed?: boolean
  isFirstRightFixed?: boolean
  colSpan?: number
  rowSpan?: number
  index?: number
  parent?: TableColumnData
  _resizeWidth?: number
  /** 布局计算后的最终列宽 */
  _realWidth?: number
}

export interface TableProps {
  columns: TableColumnData[]
  data: TableData[]
  bordered?: boolean | TableBorder
  rowSelection?: TableRowSelection

}
export type Sorter = { field: string; direction: 'ascend' | 'descend' }
export type Filters = Record<string, string[]>
export type TableDataPath<Row extends TableData> = RowPath<Row>
export type TypedTableRow<Row extends TableData> = Row & { children?: TypedTableRow<Row>[] }

export type TypedTableColumn<Row extends TableData> = Omit<TableColumnData, ColumnOwnedKey> & {
  dataIndex?: TableDataPath<Row>
  render?: (data: { record: Row; column: TypedTableColumn<Row>; rowIndex: number }) => VNodeChild
  sortable?: TypedTableSortable<Row>
  filterable?: TypedTableFilterable<Row>
  children?: TypedTableColumn<Row>[]
  parent?: TypedTableColumn<Row>
  bodyCellClass?: ClassName | ((record: Row) => ClassName)
  summaryCellClass?: ClassName | ((record: Row) => ClassName)
  bodyCellStyle?: CSSProperties | ((record: Row) => CSSProperties)
  summaryCellStyle?: CSSProperties | ((record: Row) => CSSProperties)
}

export type TypedTableConfig<Row extends TableData> = Omit<TableProps, ConfigOwnedKey> & {
  data: TypedTableRow<Row>[]
  columns: TypedTableColumn<Row>[]
  rowKey: TypedTableRowKey<Row>
  expandable?: TypedTableExpandable<Row>
  loadMore?: (record: Row, done: (children?: TypedTableRow<Row>[]) => void) => void
  spanMethod?: TypedSpanMethod<Row>
  summarySpanMethod?: TypedSpanMethod<Row>
  rowClass?: ClassName | ((record: Row, rowIndex: number) => ClassName)
  summary?: false | ((params: { columns: TypedTableColumn<Row>[]; data: Row[] }) => TypedTableRow<Row>[])
}
